Callout.Name: Escape - Prison Grounds
Callout.Message: Inmate missing at roll call, believed still on the grounds.

Script.Line: One missing at roll call and the gate has not been touched.
He is not on the yard and he is not in the block. That leaves the grounds.
He has been talking about the wall for a fortnight. Everybody heard him.

Lines.Approach: One missing at roll call and no vehicle reported, so he is on foot and he is close.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
